events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; (bash cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh > /tmp/t253-stack.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8790/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "^[1-5]" && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; tail -5 /tmp/t253-stack.log; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | grep -E ":(8[0-9]{3}|9[0-9]{3})" | sort -u | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run simulator probes against local stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; for p in probe-stripe-refunds probe-t268 probe-twilio-job probe-twilio-sms probe-funnel-whatsapp probe-resend-hooks probe-t263 probe-t265 probe-t266 probe-t267 probe-dns-elsewhere; do f=scripts/$p.mjs; [ -f $f ] || continue; out=$(timeout 240 node $f 2>&1); echo "== $p exit=$? $(echo "$out" | grep -ciE '^(FAIL|✗)|FAILED') fails | $(echo "$out" | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"; done

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; for p in probe-stripe-refunds probe-t268 probe-twilio-job probe-twilio-sms probe-funnel-whatsapp probe-resend-hooks probe-t263 probe-t265 probe-t266 probe-t267 probe-dns-elsewhere; do f=scripts/$p.mjs; [ -f $f ] || continue; out=$(node $f 2>&1); e=$?; echo "== $p exit=$e | $(echo "$out" | grep -iE 'FAIL' | head -3 | cut -c1-140 | tr '\n' ' ') | $(echo "$out" | tail -1 | cut -c1-100)"; done
